checks.ADVANCEMENT: each of them led at full time there, or the tie was level and went to penalties
checks.ELIMINATION: the club that did not go through plays no further fixture — the third-place match being the one lawful replay, granted only where the final is read
checks.ORDER: every fixture of the earlier round kicks off strictly before every fixture of the one it feeds
checks.PAIRING: the clubs of a round yield exactly one distinct earlier fixture each, covering twice as many clubs

no_round_label_exists: Neither source carries a round, stage or leg field. The states record has ten keys and none of them is a round; ESPN's competitions[0].notes[].headline is empty on every fixture but the penalty ones, where it names a shootout winner and still not the round. Every round below was DERIVED by walking backwards from the last pair of fixtures, and each round says how.

refusal.at: the round that would feed the round of 32
refusal.why: one or more clubs of this round have no earlier fixture at all

rounds.derived_by: the last two fixtures are the final and the third-place match; the FINAL is the one contested by the two clubs that advanced from the semi-finals, which is why it is not simply 'the last one played' (in 2024 both were played on the same day)
rounds.name: Final

rounds.derived_by: the fixture each finalist and each third-place contestant played immediately before, accepted because the four checks held (PAIRING, ADVANCEMENT, ELIMINATION with the third-place exception, ORDER)

They are the group or league phase: 2024 ran groups of three, 2025 and 2026 a single league phase. Group membership and league position could be GUESSED from who played whom; they are not, because a guessed bracket slot is a claim about the tournament made by a layout.

won_is_not_advanced: `ft_winner` is who was AHEAD AT NINETY PLUS STOPPAGE, which is what Kalshi settles a three-way on and what this repo means by won; a shootout pays nothing there and cost real money on bet 42. `advanced` is who went through, which for a level tie is a different club-or-nobody and is derived from progression. Both are carried on every tie, never collapsed into one.
